body: Conlang dossier for phonology, writing script, grammar mechanics, naming roots, and everyday idioms.

fields.hint: Consonant clusters, vowel harmony, tonal pitch, or trill rules

sampleValues.Language Family & Speakers: Highland Liturgical Family; spoken across the Terraced Valleys and scholar-courts
sampleValues.Sound Inventory & Cadence: Melodic VSO cadence rich in liquid 'l' and 'r' consonants, soft 'th' fricatives, and long open vowels.
sampleValues.Script Medium & Direction: Vertical knotted-brush calligraphy written top-to-bottom on oiled cedar bark
sampleValues.Word Order & Inflection Rules: Verb-Subject-Object; nouns decline for animate vs. stone/elemental classes.
sampleValues.Core Lexicon & Idioms:
Sola-var | Lantern-walk | Safe journey after dusk
Kael-mor | Hearth-silence | Formal truce between feuding clans
